Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans, giving you a faster way to organize how you and your team work. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, capture the exact combination of filters, grouping, and sorting you rely on most, then return to it instantly whenever you need it. Each user can save up to 50 views, so you have plenty of room to set up dashboards for different projects, clients, or workflows. Views aren't limited to personal use, either: any view can be shared with a team, making it easy to keep everyone aligned on priorities, deadlines, or status without repeating setup work. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or checking in on a client's progress, Saved Views helps your whole team see the same picture at a glance. No extra setup, no waiting for a future release — it's ready right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
